# ISSUES WITH SIZE OF PERSON IN RESULT

Bypass the Pad Inbound Video Group when not needed.

I had to pad the inbound video to get the person to end up the correct size. The above nodes on the right is to test padding for getting it right to match your ref image using a  single shot image from the video inbound. Then when you have it where you think it is about right for size, transfer settings to the ImagePadKJ node for the inbound video to be padded before the width and height is set.

# MARKDKBERRY dot com

Find everything via my [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/c/AIMakingMovies)
or [YT channel](https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry)

Date: 29th June 2026

This workflow is for motion transfer movement or lipsync. e.g. taking a dancer video and applying it to a ref image, or taking a dialogue scene and applying it to your own character ref image. 

I will then take it to 24fps interpolation, and then to LTX to upscale and detailer and force lipsync and character back in stronger. See my YT channel for how I do that. It will be a wip to work out strengths to not lose the Scail 2 results.

**This workflow came originally from Veteran AI here but has been adapted to my uses** - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dT5M0gE77JA

"Currently requires PR (merged to ComfyUI main early June 2026 so just update to that point)": https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/14373
